moments.title: Halloween Weekend
moments.blurb: The UK gears up for Halloween on Saturday, October 31st, with costume parties, trick-or-treating, and spooky events across the country.

angles.name: Spooky Celebrations
angles.copy: Get ready for a frightfully good weekend! Halloween is officially on Saturday, and the UK is going all out with costumes, carved pumpkins, and trick-or-treating. What are your plans?

angles.name: Kids' Halloween Fun
angles.copy: From pumpkin patches to trick-or-treating, Halloween on Saturday is a huge hit with families! Share your best costume ideas for the little monsters.

moments.title: Strictly Halloween Special
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing airs its much-anticipated Halloween Special on BBC One this Saturday, October 31st, with the remaining couples performing spooky routines.

angles.name: Strictly Spooktacular
angles.copy: Grab your popcorn and get ready to rumba with ghosts! The Strictly Come Dancing Halloween Special is THIS SATURDAY on BBC One. Who are you rooting for to cast a spell on the judges?

angles.name: Halloween Week Dances
angles.copy: It's Halloween Week in the Strictly ballroom! Expect ghoulishly good routines and incredible costumes this Saturday night. Who's going to deliver the most thrilling performance?

moments.title: Premier League Matchday 9
moments.blurb: The Premier League continues with Matchday 9 this weekend, featuring big clashes including Chelsea vs Manchester United and Manchester City vs Brighton on Saturday, October 31st.

angles.name: Football Weekend
angles.copy: Huge Premier League action this Saturday! Chelsea take on Manchester United in a massive clash, plus Man City face Brighton. Who are you backing for the points?

angles.name: Saturday Showdowns
angles.copy: Matchday 9 is here! What are your score predictions for the Premier League games this Saturday? Don't miss Chelsea vs Man Utd!

moments.title: Bonfire Night Approaching
moments.blurb: Bonfire Night, or Guy Fawkes Night, is celebrated across the UK with fireworks displays and bonfires on Thursday, November 5th.

angles.name: Fireworks Prep
angles.copy: Get ready for rockets and bonfires! Guy Fawkes Night is just a week away on November 5th. What's your favourite thing about Bonfire Night?

angles.name: Remember, Remember
angles.copy: Penny for the Guy! Bonfire Night is next Thursday. Planning to head to a display or watch from home?

moments.title: Randy Jackson turns 65
moments.blurb: Randy Jackson, member of The Jackson 5 and solo artist, celebrates his 65th birthday today, October 29th.

angles.name: Randy's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 65th birthday to Randy Jackson of The Jackson 5! What's your favourite Jackson's track?

moments.title: Johnny Marr turns 63
moments.blurb: Iconic guitarist Johnny Marr, best known for his work with The Smiths, celebrates his 63rd birthday on Saturday, October 31st.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 63rd birthday this Saturday to the incredible Johnny Marr! What's your favourite Smiths song featuring his legendary guitar work?

angles.name: Chili Peppers Birthday
angles.copy: Give it away, give it away, give it away now! Red Hot Chili Peppers' Anthony Kiedis celebrates his 64th birthday on Sunday. What's your favourite RHCP anthem?

moments.title: ABBA Voyage Continues
moments.blurb: ABBA Voyage offers a VIP Premium Package show at the ABBA Arena in London on Friday, October 30th, continuing its acclaimed virtual residency.

angles.name: ABBA in London
angles.copy: Fancy a trip to the ABBA Arena? ABBA Voyage continues its incredible run this Friday with a VIP Premium Package show. Who's been, and who wants to go?

moments.title: The Stylistics in Cardiff

angles.name: Cardiff Soul Night
angles.copy: Get ready for a night of timeless soul! The incredible Stylistics are playing the New Theatre Cardiff this Saturday. Who's heading out for a smooth evening?

moments.title: Dutty Moonshine Big Band in Exeter
moments.blurb: The Dutty Moonshine Big Band brings their unique blend of big-band swing and heavy bass to the University of Exeter Great Hall on Saturday, October 31st.

angles.name: Exeter Halloween Gig
angles.copy: Looking for something different this Halloween in Exeter? The Dutty Moonshine Big Band is at the Great Hall on Saturday for a night of electro-swing and bass!

moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Launch Date

angles.name: Jungle Countdown

angles.name: Ant & Dec Return
angles.copy: Ant & Dec are back for I'm A Celebrity... starting November 16th! Get ready for bushtucker trials and plenty of drama. Who's your dream campmate?

angles.name: Stevie Live in London
